# BasicDAGColorsBase
Also called: BaseDAGColors
## Overview
BasicDAGColorsBase is a base class for DAG color data that decouples leaf count storage from the main geometry array using an enclosed leaves array [S1, unofficial]. It differs from sibling methods by establishing the base array layout for enclosed leaf counts, whereas [BasicDAGUncompressedColors](6741-basicdaguncompressedcolors.md) focuses on raw storage and [Mixture Graph](11065-mixture-graph.md) introduces mixture-based color representations [G].
## Shared principles
The core mechanism relies on an `enclosedLeaves` array to determine the number of leaves, which dictates the scope of subsequent operations such as color error computation [BasicDAGColorErrors](6743-basicdagcolorerrors.md). This structure decouples leaf count storage from the main geometry array [S1, unofficial]. The data layout consists of:
- `topLevels`: A `uint32` value storing the number of top levels in the DAG hierarchy [S1, unofficial].
- `enclosedLeaves`: A `StaticArray<EnclosedLeavesType>` storing leaf counts for upper-level nodes [S1, unofficial].
## Subtopics

### [BasicDAGColorErrors](6743-basicdagcolorerrors.md)
Provides a binary quality control mechanism for [sparse voxel DAG](#5984-sparse-voxel-dag.md) color data by computing an error flag between compressed and uncompressed color representations. It differs from sibling methods that may store continuous error metrics or skip validation by returning a strict binary indicator (1.0 or 0.0) based on a fixed threshold, ensuring [adaptive quality](#22086-adaptive-quality.md) control without storing additional floating-point error values per leaf.

## Background
The concept originates from the HashDAG implementation [S1, unofficial]. Not given in the sources is the specific development history or additional architectural details beyond the base class definition.
